name: English

_purpose.banner_base_url: first line of the banner when a profile window points Claude Code away from Anthropic; the person decides from it which window to use for what - plain, never alarming
_purpose.banner_rules: where the rules of that window come from; {sources} is a list of file names
_purpose.banner_key: reassures that the API key never lands in a file
_purpose.red_window: banner of the window for red (confidential) work that runs only on this computer
_purpose.doctor_remote_ok: doctor: Remote Control works with this setup
_purpose.doctor_remote_off: doctor: Remote Control does not work; {why} names the variable or the address
_purpose.doctor_base: doctor: where Claude Code sends requests; {where} is an address and the file that set it
_purpose.doctor_rules: doctor: which managed rules apply; {sources} is a list
_purpose.doctor_advisor_off: doctor: the advisor tool is off; {why} names the cause
_purpose.policy_denied: the company policy forbids a vendor; {vendor} and {why}
_purpose.crew_refused: a crew member is not started; {member} and {why}
_purpose.gateway_people: why a gateway is never written for people
_purpose.local_none: no local model server answered; {tried} is a list of addresses
_purpose.local_load: result of the load measurement in plain words

banner_base_url: In this window Claude Code talks to {host}: Remote Control, cloud sessions, the advisor and your organisation's server-managed settings do not work here. Your usual Claude window keeps them all.
banner_rules: Rules in this window come from: {sources}.
banner_key: The key is read from the system keychain when the window opens; it is never written to a file.
red_window: Red window: the model runs on this computer, Ollama's cloud is off and Claude Code sends out nothing it does not need. Remote Control is off in this window only.
doctor_remote_ok: Remote Control: available with this setup.
policy_denied: The company policy does not allow {vendor} ({why}).
gateway_people: A gateway is for scripts and CI only: behind it people would lose Remote Control and the organisation's rules. People get a profile window instead.
local_none: No local model server answers on this computer (tried {tried}).
local_load: {model}: {single} tokens a second for one request, {total} with {n} at once - enough for about {people} people working with an agent.
